name: Barycentric Interpolation on Tetrahedra
definition: Interpolation within a tetrahedron (3-simplex) using 3D barycentric coordinates, extending 2D barycentric coordinates by relating four tetrahedral subvolumes.
summary: Barycentric Interpolation on Tetrahedra computes a weighted sum of vertex feature vectors using barycentric coordinates, distinguishing itself by relying solely on vertex values rather than gradients to ensure C0 continuity.
